title: ba-breakdown business-rule catalogue (RULES.json)
description: Every business rule stated ONCE, with a stable id. Stories reference rules; they never restate them. This is the single change that both deepens the analysis and shrinks the artifact: a threshold like 'free shipping at or above 1500 THB' lives in one row instead of being paraphrased inside three acceptance criteria that can drift apart.

audit_id.description: Same value as the INDEX manifest.

statement.description: The rule in one testable sentence with concrete values. 'Reasonable delay' is not a rule - it is an open question (set open: true and link it).

type.description: state-transition rules MUST name the entity whose state machine they guard, via applies_to_entities.

source_ref.description: Where in the raw request this rule comes from. A rule with no source is an assumption, not a rule.

regulatory_tie.description: The regulation this rule implements, when it implements one.

open.description: True when the source states the rule exists but not its value. An open rule still gets an id so stories can reference it - it blocks elaboration of those stories, not the breakdown.
